description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取大陆场内公募基金（ETF、LOF）的K线数据。可按基金代码、时间范围进行筛选，返回日期、开盘价、收盘价、最高价、最低价、成交量、成交额、涨跌幅、复权因子等数据。当用户想查看某场内公募基金的K线走势和技术形态，或用于溢价率计算与套利分析时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain K-line (candlestick) data for A-share funds (both exchange-traded and non-exchange-traded). Filters can be applied by fund code and date range, returning fields such as date, open, close, high, low, volume, amount, price change, and adjustment factor. Call this interface when users want to view the K-line trend or technical patterns of a specific fund.

descriptions: 结束信息日期。用于获取时间范围内的数据，默认值为今天结束。
